# Tulsk Brain

> A personal knowledge base for your Hermes agent. Clone, configure, let your agent build it.

Repo: https://github.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain

## Core entry points

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/AGENTS.md): Operating protocol for AI agents. Start here.
- [RESOLVER.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/RESOLVER.md): Filing decision tree. Read before creating any page.
- [schema.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/schema.md): Page conventions and templates.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/README.md): Project overview.

## Directory structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| [people/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/people/) | One page per person |
| [companies/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/companies/) | One page per organization |
| [deals/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/deals/) | Financial transactions with terms |
| [meetings/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/meetings/) | Meeting records with analysis |
| [projects/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/projects/) | Active work with specs |
| [ideas/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/ideas/) | Possibilities not yet built |
| [concepts/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/concepts/) | Mental models and frameworks |
| [writing/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/writing/) | Essays and drafts |
| [programs/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/programs/) | Major life workstreams |
| [org/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/org/) | Organization strategy |
| [media/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/media/) | Public narrative and content |
| [personal/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/personal/) | Private notes |
| [sources/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/sources/) | Raw data imports |
| [prompts/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/prompts/) | Reusable LLM prompts |
| [inbox/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/inbox/) | Unsorted captures |
| [archive/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/archive/) | Dead pages |
| [templates/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/templates/) | Page templates |

## Key principles

| Principle | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| MECE | Every piece of knowledge → exactly one directory |
| Two-layer | Compiled truth above, timeline below |
| Enrich on signal | Every meeting/email/mention triggers updates |
| Source everything | Claims cite their source and date |
| Cross-reference | Entities link to related entities |

## Page templates

| Template | Use |
|----------|-----|
| [templates/person.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/templates/person.md) | Person pages |
| [templates/company.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/templates/company.md) | Company pages |
| [templates/meeting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/templates/meeting.md) | Meeting pages |
| [templates/project.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/templates/project.md) | Project pages |
| [templates/concept.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain/main/templates/concept.md) | Concept pages |

## Quick start

```bash
# Clone and configure
git clone https://github.com/RiggdAI/tulsk-brain.git ~/brain
cd ~/brain
rm -rf .git && git init && git add -A && git commit -m "Initial brain"

# Point Hermes to brain
# Add to SOUL.md: "Read ~/brain/RESOLVER.md before creating any brain page."
```

## For AI agents

Read AGENTS.md for the full operating protocol.
Read RESOLVER.md before creating any page.
